name: contract_version

name: runtime_root
description: Ignored Jerez runtime root that contains verified VB and MCMC evidence.

name: expected_source_jobs
description: Imported shared-backbone source jobs required before article-window scoring.

name: expected_source_failures
description: No imported source failures are allowed.

name: expected_vb_components
description: Article-window VB components required for compact MCMC initializers.

name: expected_initializers
description: One compact top-level initializer per scenario-model cell.

name: expected_mcmc_workers
description: All Jerez MCMC chain workers required before score reconstruction.

name: expected_scenarios
description: The article fixture contains eight synthetic mechanisms.

name: expected_models
description: Joint and independent QDESN/exQDESN readouts are compared within AL and exAL likelihood families.

name: expected_model_cells
description: Eight scenarios by four model families.

name: expected_contrasts
description: One joint-minus-independent contrast for AL and one for exAL in each scenario.

name: primary_metric
description: Known-DGP expected finite-grid quantile score for the issued quantile action.

name: score_scale
description: Each ordinate is twice the quantile check loss.

name: tau_grid
description: Frozen seven-level article quantile grid.

name: trapezoidal_weights
description: Trapezoidal weights for the finite observed tau range.

name: renormalize_weights
description: Weights are not rescaled beyond the observed 0.05 to 0.95 tau range.

name: forecast_row_source
description: Forecast scoring uses exactly design$score_local and no tuning-window or outcome-selected subset.

name: canonical_action
description: Pool retained posterior means by chain-balanced parameter path and apply the existing rowwise monotone contract.

name: posterior_point_summary
description: Primary comparison uses posterior score mean.

name: posterior_sensitivity_summary
description: Posterior median is retained as a compact robustness diagnostic.

name: credible_interval
description: Equal-tailed posterior interval probability.

name: credible_interval_probabilities
description: Equal-tailed 95 percent interval endpoints.

name: score_draws_per_chain
description: Equally spaced retained draws per chain used for primary score uncertainty; this uses all AL retained draws and a chain-balanced exAL subset.

name: sensitivity_draws_per_chain
description: Equally spaced retained draws per chain used for independent coupling-seed sensitivity.

name: draw_selection
description: Draw selection covers the retained span without outcome-dependent subsampling.

name: chunk_size
description: Maximum score-draw chunk size for qhat reconstruction.

name: joint_draw_coupling
description: Joint model draws preserve cross-tau retained-draw identity.

name: independent_draw_coupling
description: Independent models use seeded within-chain per-tau permutations to represent product posterior coupling.

name: primary_pairing_seed
description: Frozen primary independent product-posterior coupling seed.

name: sensitivity_pairing_seeds
description: Frozen alternate independent coupling seeds for sensitivity only.

name: contrast_pairing_seed
description: Frozen scalar score-draw pairing seed for joint-minus-independent contrasts.

name: qhat_equivalence_tolerance
description: Maximum absolute difference allowed between reconstructed posterior-mean qhat and each worker's stored validation paths.

name: score_rank_rhat_ceiling
description: Preferred rank-normalized Rhat ceiling for score functionals.

name: score_bulk_ess_floor
description: Preferred bulk ESS floor for score functionals.

name: score_tail_ess_floor
description: Preferred tail ESS floor for score functionals.

name: raw_crossing_rate_review
description: Raw pre-contract crossing rate above one percent is review-level.

name: standardized_adjustment_review
description: Mean monotone adjustment over DGP scale above one percent is review-level.

name: regret_tolerance
description: Hard tolerance for negative expected regret against the oracle score.

name: analytic_integration_tolerance
description: Tolerance for analytic versus numerical expected-check-loss validation.

name: monte_carlo_tolerance
description: Tolerance for deterministic Monte Carlo formula validation.

name: comparison_center
description: A strictly lower posterior mean is the descriptive numerical ordering.

name: interval_interpretation
description: Overlapping equal-tailed 95 percent intervals imply uncertain strength of evidence and do not erase numerical ordering.

name: practical_relative_margin
description: One-percent relative margin used for descriptive practical contrast summaries.

name: posterior_probability_floor
description: Probability threshold retained for evidence-strength labels rather than retuning.

name: descriptive_improvement_policy
description: Any strictly favorable posterior mean is retained as a descriptive gain.

name: realized_score
description: Realized finite-grid aCRPS is secondary.

name: average_quantile_loss
description: Average quantile loss across rows and tau is secondary.

name: oracle_recovery
description: Fit and forecast oracle MAE/RMSE are recovery diagnostics.

name: raw_crossings
description: Raw crossings are diagnostics only before the monotone contract.

name: finite_values
description: All score values and reconstructed draw blocks must be finite.

name: contract_crossings
description: Contracted quantile grids must have zero crossing pairs.

name: source_completeness
description: Missing or incomplete source
column8: or MCMC evidence stops score finalization.

name: manifest_verification
description: Worker
column7: and packet manifests must verify by size and SHA-256.

name: phase182_scope
description: The Muscat Phase182 19-level dense-grid crossing lane is excluded from this seven-level score packet.
